verdict.rationale: cubic generates AI insights and suggestions from the user's code and PR data inside the product. This includes automatic PR reviews flagging bugs and improvements, AI chat answering questions about a PR and the codebase, AI wikis with architecture diagrams, and codebase scans. A community user corroborates that cubic gives useful technical explanations. Missing for 10: AI-generated narrative insights over the analytics data (the dashboards present metrics only), and current-status confirmation of the AI chat/sidebar, whose docs sit under an 'archive' path.
